description: What is this token's X account, and can you trust the link? Its X handle, website and Telegram from its DexScreener profile, checked against the token's own onchain metadata (Solana) and the website domain's registration date: flags an X handle that differs between the two, a domain registered the week of launch, mutable metadata or no socials. Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Solana. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

address.description: Token contract (0x) or Solana mint address
